text: Program Description Ranked as top film school in China, Beijing Film Academy's film production international program is a 4-year English-teaching program, offering all kinds of professional courses including Directing, Cinematography, Post-production, and etc. We're committed to cultivate talents to master the whole workflow of filmmaking. In addition to gain professional knowledges, you will also have opportunity to learn valuable skills from masters in the industry. You will meet interesting people, develop yourself, and create connections which will bring you endless opportunities in the future. With rapid growth of China film industry, we believe it will be a perfect platform for you to start off your career in film industry. We provide industry standard facilities to all students in the department, including professional editing studios, sound studios, color correction studios, screening rooms, as well as a range of cinematic cameras, lighting products etc. -- Everything you may need to make your script into film. Most students and teachers in the department speak English and willing to offer help, so you don't need to worry about the language barrier. We also offer Chinese classes during the study period. So, what are you waiting for? Join us to start your new chapter in film!
